title: Collaboration wiring: metering, purge, relay delivery and the remaining API modules
goal: The pieces that were built and tested on their own but are not yet served or are stubbed locally run in the API and relay, so a shared session is metered, kept and cleaned up and the clients can read usage, notifications and plans.
scope_in: Monthly usage metering behind the entitlement check (today it answers allowed): B075's counters feed B080, with B076's 80/100 percent signals.
The purge of deleted workspaces and ended sessions' history (B090, B055) as a job the worker runs.
Delivery of host changes and session state to the relay's control channel (B054's `hostNotifier`), with the retry the store already has.

The built API modules served from `modules.ts` when configured: usage, notifications and inbox, plans and entitlement reads, snapshots and history, webhooks management; each skipped with one log line when unconfigured.
Production sign-ups get the free plan: a test proves it and that `DEV_DEFAULT_PLAN` is refused in production.
scope_out: Stripe checkout (B070-B073 stay as they are), real mail providers, deployment.
Relay durable log replay for very long reconnects (B042, B055).
build_against: The B012 dev stack and the testkit containers.
interfaces: The routes of B074, B075, B065, B066, B069, B056, B081 on the API; a worker job for purge; a relay control endpoint for host changes.
acceptance: A session that uses more minutes than the plan allows is refused at the entitlement check with the contract's error, and the owner gets the 80 percent notice first (test).
Deleting a workspace removes its sessions' history and snapshots after the grace period (worker test).
A host change made through the API reaches the relay and connected clients see `control.host_changed` (integration test).
Each served module answers on the dev stack; one with missing configuration is skipped with one log line (test).
A production configuration gives new accounts the free plan and refuses `DEV_DEFAULT_PLAN` (test).
guardrails: MUST NOT put tokens, tickets, invite or link secrets, key material or e-mail addresses in logs.
MUST keep contracts/ as it is: this lane builds against the contract text and fails closed where the contract is silent.
MUST fail closed on metering errors (an unreadable counter does not grant extra usage beyond the grace the contract allows).
failure_modes: Relay unreachable -> host changes stay queued and retry with backoff.
Counter store down -> the entitlement check uses its cached answer for the documented time, then refuses.
notes: The relay durable log replay for very long reconnects is B055/B042 territory and is not in this card. Also changes (does not own) apps/api/src/{modules,context}.ts (B102), docs/api-service.md (B102) and apps/api/src/collab.ts (B103).
